name: La Rata Remix
author: La Rata
description: Seeded chaos for 1-4 players with six interactive card boosters, an expanded card collection, three new potions and unusual relics. An optional Rat King finale with two Kingsguard escorts and gradually increasing attack damage. English, German and Simplified Chinese localization. Requires the public game branch v0.107.1 and BaseLib 3.4.7. Start a new run.
